newsitem.title: USA: API says U.S. crude stocks fell in week.
newsitem.headline: API says U.S. crude stocks fell in week.

text.p: U.S. crude oil stocks held in primary storage fell 868,000 barrels in the week ended Nov 29 to 299.41 million barrels from 300.28 million barrels the prior week, the American Petroleum Institute (API) said Tuesday.
API said that crude stocks excluding PADD 5 (Petroleum Administration for Defense District) fell 1.16 million barrels in the week to 233.53 million barrels.
Distillate stocks rose 1.85 million barrels to 120.06 million from 118.22 million the previous week. PADD 1 distillate stocks fell 173,000 barrels to 44.99 million.
API said gasoline stocks rose 1.93 million barrels in the week to 188.63 million barrels from 186.70 million barrels. Percent of capacity was unchanged in the week at 93.7 percent.
Reformulated gasoline stocks (RFG) fell 1.82 million barrels to 36.52 million barrels from 38.34 million barrels in the previous week.
Crude runs to processing units fell to 14.30 million barrels from 14.31 million barrels.
Residual fuel stocks in the latest week rose to 40.08 million barrels from 38.58 million in the previous week, and crude oil imports fell to 6.48 million barrels per day from 6.94 million, API said.
